title: Calisthenics Skill Builder 2
summary: Level 2 skill session: frog stand to crow, kick-ups, pull-up and dip negatives, tuck L-sit. Start once Skill Builder 1 is done. Move up a rung after hitting every set in two sessions.

steps.name: Wrist rocks
steps.cue: On hands and knees: rock forward and back palms flat, then fingers pointing toward knees, then on the backs of your hands.

steps.name: Band pull-aparts
steps.cue: Skip if no band. Squeeze shoulder blades together.

steps.name: Scapular pull-ups
steps.cue: Hang with straight arms; pull shoulder blades down and back, then relax. Elbows never bend.

steps.name: Scapular push-ups
steps.cue: In a plank, let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away.

steps.name: Deep squat pry
steps.cue: Sit deep, elbows inside knees, gently shift side to side.

steps.name: Cat-cow
steps.cue: Slow, full range through the spine.

steps.name: Hard plank, hands turned out
steps.cue: Squeeze everything. Wakes the shoulders up for handstands.

steps.name: Hollow body hold
steps.cue: Low back pressed down, arms by ears, ribs in, legs long. This is the handstand line, lying down. Bend the knees to make it easier.

steps.name: Cartwheel bail
steps.cue: From a lunge, hands down, kick up a little and turn out to one side, stepping down. Your exit with no wall: learn it before kick-ups.

steps.name: Frog stand (Handstand Level 2)
steps.cue: Knees on the backs of the arms, lean forward until the feet float. Pillow in front of your face. Ladder: 1 frog 15s → 2 frog 30s → 3 crow 10s → 4 crow 30s → 5 tuck hops ×8 → 6 tuck hold 3s

steps.name: Feet-up pike hold (Handstand Level 2)
steps.cue: Feet on a chair, hips over shoulders, arms by ears. Ladder: 1 feet-up pike 30s → 2 kick-ups 5/leg, bail each → 3 kick-ups 5/leg, catch 2s → 4 free 5s → 5 free 15s → 6 free 30s+

steps.name: Pull-up negative (Pull Level 2)
steps.cue: Jump or step to chin over the bar, lower in 5s to a dead hang. Ladder: 1 negatives 3×5 → 2 band-assisted 3×5 → 3 band-assisted 3×8 → 4 strict 3×3 → 5 strict 3×5 → 6 strict 3×8

steps.name: Dip negative (Dip Level 2)
steps.cue: Start in a locked support, lower in 4–5s until shoulders are just below elbows, step back up. Ladder: 1 negatives 3×5 → 2 band-assisted 3×8 → 3 strict 3×3 → 4 3×5 → 5 3×8 → 6 3×12

steps.name: Tuck L-sit (L-sit Level 2)
steps.cue: Feet off the floor, knees to chest, shoulders pushed down. Ladder: 1 tuck 20s → 2 tuck 30s → 3 one leg out 10s/side → 4 one leg out 20s/side → 5 full L 10s → 6 full L 20s+
